name: homeschool
description: Faro — Czech–Italian hybrid curriculum app; single-command dev and deployment for backend + frontend

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.deploy: npm run setup && npm --prefix backend run db:migrate && npm --prefix backend run db:seed && npm run build && npm start
scripts.container:build: CONTAINER_TOOL=${CONTAINER_TOOL:-$(command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf podman || printf docker)}; $CONTAINER_TOOL build -t ${IMAGE:-docker.io/mauroferra/homeschool:latest} .
scripts.container:push: CONTAINER_TOOL=${CONTAINER_TOOL:-$(command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf podman || printf docker)}; $CONTAINER_TOOL push ${IMAGE:-docker.io/mauroferra/homeschool:latest}
